scope: Independent local headless Chromium visual layout fixtures on the real board_game.html with production BoardTavernReveal.respond and CSS. Wait data-ready and 900ms before measured capture.

smallPhone.selection: Four longest total dialogue/reaction-label blocks plus requested crown and straw-hat checks.
smallPhone.originalFinding: Robin acceptance animation put a very small visible hair sliver into the skip-button rectangle (14 source-alpha samples, approximately 2.3 square screen pixels).
smallPhone.fix: Only portrait max-height700 media rule changed hostFrame from inherited top4% / height55% to top10% / height49%; Chopper-specific top13% / height42% unchanged.

measurements.method: Sample source alpha threshold64 at step2, project through contain-fit object placement and live CSS transformation matrix, apply frame fade alpha, compare visible pixels to speech/skip/viewport. Ignore empty image-element-box overlap.

visualReview.finding: No visible head/antler/crown truncation or obscured dialogue in reviewed views. The small Robin hair/skip collision is resolved.

sourceHashes.deltaVerification: Replacing only the new top10%/height49% declaration with the old height55% declaration in-memory reproduces the exact prior CSS SHA. Main60 media conditions do not match changed rule.

limitations: Automated Chromium viewport emulation, not physical-device or human-play acceptance.
Checks capture one ready+900ms frame per selected phase; not proof of all animation instants or every possible viewport.
Controlled presentation markup does not test recruitment RNG, settlement, saves or network synchronization.
No deployment claim. No production files were modified by this QA script.
